attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole life is «Ο Άγιος Σωσίθεος μαρτύρησε δια ξίφους». No year, so no `dates` object. The site's gloss under the name — a tragic poet of Alexandria of the third century before Christ — is its standing note on the name itself and not on the saint. The corpus holds nobody of this name. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
